signInIntroduction: Sign in with an approved Google account. Access is granted separately for the console and each protected {domain} domain.
returnAfterSignIn: After signing in you will be returned to the page you asked for.
oauthNotConfigured: Google OAuth is not configured yet
oauthSetup: Sign-in stays disabled until this console has an OAuth client. To finish setup:
oauthCreate: In Google Cloud Console, open APIs & Services → Credentials and create an OAuth client ID of type Web application.
oauthRedirect: Register this exact authorized redirect URI:
oauthCredentials: Put the client ID and secret in the console’s .env as GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, then restart the console.
signInUnavailable: Sign-in is not available right now.
accountDenied: Your Google account does not have access to this resource.
accountUninvited: Your Google account has not been invited to any Console-managed domain.
askOwner: Ask the Console owner to add your Google account or grant this domain.
sessionValid: Your sign-in is still valid for any other domains the owner granted to you.
alreadyPending: The Console owner already has this access request in the incoming queue.
ownerCanApprove: The Console owner can now approve or deny this request from the incoming invites page.

forms.one: You can try again in about {count} second.
forms.other: You can try again in about {count} seconds.

noRoute: There is no route configured for {host}.
routeSetup: Subdomain routes are managed from the console — create one there to bring this hostname to life.
upstreamConnect: The upstream server refused the connection — nothing is listening on its port.
upstreamTimeout: The upstream server did not respond in time.
upstreamReset: The upstream server closed the connection unexpectedly.
upstreamStopped: The server behind this route is not running.
upstreamUnreachable: The server behind this route is currently unreachable.
restartServer: Start or restart the server from the console, then reload this page.
requestFailed: The request could not be completed.
